headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 was down *35 minutes* overnight when heating-loop valves were found closed — cleared at 16:34, cooking resumed.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 had two stoppages — kitchen valve HMI mismatch cleared at 14:09, then heating loop valves found closed at shift change causing a 35-minute cook delay. A-side labeler remains down; 6 pallets await re-work and tech visit scheduled Monday. Sollich 1 cleaning found possible moisture at Tunnel 1 head under investigation.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle ran strong to 523,500 pieces and completed level 2 clean; bottomer mesh found broken during final inspection and needs repair. ML1 C1 conveyor belt replaced by maintenance but still needs cleaning and ATP before next run.

resolved.title: Kitchen valve/HMI mismatch blocking caramel flow
resolved.summary: Valves showed open on HMI but were closed physically, stopping product flow to kitchen; hard reset allowed manual valve control.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:09 — "After hard reset was performed, we were able to start the valves manually... Caramel is at the Conbar right now" (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: Heating loop valves closed on corn syrup and SCM lines
resolved.summary: Steam lines and heating loop valves found closed at shift change, pipes cold, ingredients unable to send to mixing tank; delayed cooking ~35 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:34 — "system is now at a better temperature because the ingredients are being sent to the mixer faster. We're starting to cook again" (Francisco Gudino Torres). Caramel sending resumed at 17:43.

needs_attention.title: A-side labeler down, 6 pallets require re-work
needs_attention.summary: A-side labeler failing, running on slower B-side; 6 pallets produced need re-labeling; label supplier issue similar to prior pecan label problem.
needs_attention.status: Tech could not be reached Friday; follow-up scheduled for Monday. Supplier label quality issue noted by Curt Willis at 13:11.

needs_attention.title: Moisture detected at Sollich 1 Tunnel 1 head during cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Traces of moisture found on refrigeration filter and damp dust under conveyor belt at tunnel head; reported during final cleaning phase.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 02:06 for further inspection to determine moisture source and ensure sanitary conditions before area release. Only Tunnel 1 remains to be cleaned.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C1 conveyor belt needs cleaning and ATP before run
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance replaced C1 conveyor belt but did not clean it; ATP test required before starting production run.
needs_attention.status: Kimberly flagged at 07:24; Jose added tracking requirement at 07:33; Rose reminded Grey Boscan at 09:56. No completion confirmation as of window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line bottomer mesh broken
needs_attention.summary: Bottomer mesh found broken during final inspection after level 2 clean; needs repair before next run.
needs_attention.status: Discovered at 06:48 during post-clean inspection. Level 2 clean otherwise complete. Line finished production at 523,500 pieces.
